Recorded claim:
browserLoaded alone did not ensure tree rows were laid out. Entry315 adds requestAnimationFrame before focus and coordinate-based clicks; the failure selected index5 while expecting7. Current moved widget helper still waits for a frame. Continue to wait for named selection events after actions. Use a render-frame wait when the test depends on geometry, not as a universal delay for every test.
